name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest
description: Taming the Beast: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged adventurer that runs like the wind.
Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.
Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're back already! Impressive speed, friend!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
